def solve_a(n):
    a = [0] * (n + 1)
    a[1] = 1
    a[2] = 1
    for i in range(3, n + 1):
        prev_a = a[i-1]
        a[i] = a[prev_a] + a[i - prev_a]
    return a

def solve_sequence(limit):
    a = [0] * (limit + 1)
    a[1] = 1
    a[2] = 1
    
    for n in range(3, limit + 1):
        prev_a = a[n-1]
        # Check if well-defined: 1 <= prev_a < n

            print(f"Error at n={n}: a_{n-1}={prev_a} is not in [1, {n-1}]")
            break
        
        a[n] = a[prev_a] + a[n - prev_a]

            print(f"Non-decreasing check failed at n={n}: a_{n-1}={a[n-1]}, a_n={a[n]}")
